context.body: Authorized leadership expands beyond Moses and beyond the gathered tent group.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD takes from the Spirit on Moses and places it on seventy elders, including two who remain in the camp.
observations.label: God shares the Spirit among elders: action

observations.body: The elders prophesy; Joshua objects; Moses wishes all the LORD’s people had the Spirit.
observations.label: God shares the Spirit among elders: response

observations.body: take of the Spirit · rested · prophesied · all the LORD’s people
observations.label: Words in Numbers 11:16–30

payload.posture: Read Numbers 11:16–30 as presence in the wilderness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The text speaks of taking from Moses’ Spirit without portraying Moses as depleted.
payload.title: God shares the Spirit among elders
